description: Search Polemia's free public library of ready-made quizzes. Instant and free. Use it when the user wants a quiz on a common topic and does not need a new one written. Returns up to 10 quizzes, each with a title, question count, kind, language and play_url (the quiz's page, where the user starts a live game with it).

language.description: Only quizzes in this language (BCP-47). Leave out for every language.

query.description: A word or two about the topic, e.g. "space", "football", "Christmas".

name: find_quizzes

total.description: How many quizzes match in all.

title: Find ready-made Polemia quizzes
